page.layout: One printed page (right-hand page of the opening), one text column with running head at top, page number at top left; a marginal note in the left margin beside the first lines of the column; a small catchword-like "CAPVT" heading at the foot of the column, right side. Right edge shows partial text of the facing page (show-through or edge, not transcribed).

main_text.p: cereos, cineres, aquam, ramos, more vestro, tanquam salutis organa, consecrauit? Summam praeterea Romanæ ecclesiæ cum orthodoxis Patribus & inter vos dissensionem, in tractatu de Vide etiam cap. 15. huius libri. Ecclesia, prolaturus sum: vt arrogantem & perpetuam gloriationem vestram, rei veritate, humiliem. Quare frustra de successione vestra gloriaris. In qua licet Patres orthodoxi aliquam esse notam constituerint, ante quam publica in ecclesiam Christi inuecta esset apostasia & tyrannis, id tamen à nostris temporibus & ab Ecclesiæ Romanæ calamitate, alienum est. Imo, si hæc certissima veræ ecclesiæ nota est, consequitur necessario, Romanam ecclesiam non esse veram Christi Ecclesiam; quum maiorum & Apostolorum doctrinam & successionem corruperit variis modis: vt, in controuersiarum disquisitione, plenius ac planius constabit.
main_text.head: CAPVT

page.notes: The facing page edge at the right is partly visible and not transcribed. Several lines in the faint bottom area (below CAPVT) are show-through from the reverse side and were omitted. Left-margin note reads "Vide etiam cap. 15. huius libri." The word "Quare" and "Romanam" are as printed; "CAPVT" is a catchword-style heading at the foot, transcribed as printed.
